regulatory_basis: Food Labeling Standards (식품 등의 표시기준) — MFDS Notice; Food Labeling Act 2018
competent_authority: MFDS (Ministry of Food and Drug Safety)
mandatory_fields: Type of food (식품의 유형) — category classification
Ingredients list (원재료명) — descending order with quantities for compound ingredients
Nutritional information (영양성분표) — per 1 serving AND per 100g/100mL
Best before / expiry date (소비기한 — consumption by date, replaced 'best before' in 2023)
Country of origin (원산지) — for all imported foods
Allergen declaration — 22 mandatory allergens (see allergen section)
MFDS-required quality mark (if product category requires certification)

nutrition_declaration.format: Per serving AND per 100g/mL. % Daily Value based on Korean NRV. Standard table format per MFDS notice. Since 2023: 'Consumption expiry date' (소비기한) replaces 'best before date' — important change.
nutrition_declaration.nrv_reference: Korean Daily Reference Values (한국인 영양섭취기준) — MFDS Notice
nutrition_declaration.note: Korea requires % DV for each nutrient listed. Some nutrients may vary from US/EU percentages.

allergen_rules.declaration_method: Bold in ingredient list AND separate 'Contains' statement (함유). Korean language.
allergen_rules.regulatory_basis: MFDS Food Labeling Standards — Appendix (22 major allergens as of 2023)
allergen_rules.note: Korea has 22 mandatory allergens — significantly more than EU (14) or USA (9). Includes items like pine nuts, squid, and multiple shellfish species.

weights_measures.net_weight_position: Principal display panel or information panel
weights_measures.weight_units: Metric (g, mL, kg, L) mandatory. No dual labeling required.
weights_measures.regulatory_basis: Framework Act on Consumers; MFDS Food Labeling Standards

language_requirements.mandatory_language: Korean (한국어) mandatory for all required label information
language_requirements.additional_languages: Additional languages may appear alongside Korean
language_requirements.note: Products with only foreign-language labels are not permitted for sale in Korea

prohibited_claims: Disease treatment or prevention claims without MFDS health claim authorisation
Misleading comparisons implying superiority without substantiation
Claims exploiting consumers' psychological fears or anxieties
False country of origin claims

claim_rules.health_claims: Only MFDS-authorised health functional food claims permitted on HFF products
claim_rules.organic: NIAS (National Institute of Agricultural Sciences) organic certification required

special_requirements: GMO labeling mandatory since 2001 — if GM ingredient >3% of total ingredient weight
'Consumption expiry date' (소비기한) system replaced 'best before' from 2023 — significant regulatory change
Irradiated foods must be labelled 'irradiated' (방사선조사식품)
High-fructose corn syrup: must be specifically declared by name (not just 'sugar syrup')
Nutrition labeling exemptions for products <30g, certain agricultural products, and small businesses
Colour additives must be declared by specific name (not just 'colour')
enforcement_notes: MFDS enforces via product sampling and label audits. Non-compliant imports are rejected at customs. 2023 switch to 소비기한 (consumption expiry date) system is a major change — all labels must be updated.

regulatory_basis: BPOM Regulation No. 27 of 2022 — Labeling of Processed Foods; Government Regulation No. 69 of 1999
mandatory_fields: List of ingredients (daftar bahan) — in descending order
Name and address of manufacturer/importer (dalam/luar negeri)
Country of origin (negara asal) for imported products
Expiry date (tanggal kedaluwarsa — best before or use by)
BPOM Registration Number (Nomor Izin Edar — MD for domestic, ML for imported)
Halal label from BPJPH (mandatory for foods required to be halal — effective October 2024)
Bahasa Indonesia language mandatory for all required information

nutrition_declaration.format: Per serving AND per 100g/100mL. % AKG (Angka Kecukupan Gizi — Indonesian DRV). Standard table format per BPOM Reg 27/2022. Note: cholesterol not yet mandatory in Indonesia's NIP.
nutrition_declaration.nrv_reference: Indonesian Dietary Reference Values (AKG) — Ministry of Health Regulation No. 28 of 2019

allergen_rules.declaration_method: Declare in ingredient list AND in separate 'Contains' statement (Mengandung: ...)
allergen_rules.regulatory_basis: BPOM Regulation No. 27 of 2022 — Article on Allergen Labeling
allergen_rules.halal_note: Halal certification (BPJPH) becomes mandatory for processed foods phased from October 2024. Non-Halal products must be clearly marked as 'Non-Halal' (Tidak Halal).

weights_measures.weight_units: SI units (gram, mL, kg, L) mandatory
weights_measures.regulatory_basis: Law No. 2 of 1981 on Metrology; BPOM Regulation No. 27 of 2022

language_requirements.mandatory_language: Bahasa Indonesia mandatory for all required label declarations
language_requirements.additional_languages: Additional languages permitted alongside Bahasa Indonesia
language_requirements.halal_arabic: Arabic 'Halal' text on Halal label (BPJPH certification mark)

prohibited_claims: Disease cure or prevention claims
Misleading claims about nutritional value
Claims implying product can substitute a balanced diet
False Halal claims

claim_rules.organic: National organic certification required (LSO accredited by KAN)

special_requirements: BPOM Izin Edar (MD/ML) number MANDATORY — must appear on label before any product can be sold
Halal label from BPJPH mandatory for all halal-certified products (phased from October 2024)
Non-Halal foods must be clearly labelled as such and sold only in designated non-Halal sections
Front-of-pack warning for HIGH SUGAR / HIGH FAT / HIGH SODIUM under discussion (not yet mandatory)
QR code for supply chain traceability being piloted by BPOM
Expiry date format: DD/MM/YYYY or MM/YYYY
enforcement_notes: BPOM has mandatory product registration (Izin Edar) — no product can legally be sold without an MD (domestic) or ML (import) number. BPOM conducts market surveillance and can seize non-compliant products. Halal regulation (BPJPH) is a major compliance change effective October 2024.

regulatory_basis: UAE Food Safety Law No. 10 of 2015; UAE.S 9:2019 (General Requirements for Food Labeling); Emirates Authority for Standardization and Metrology (ESMA)
competent_authority: ESMA + Emirate-level authorities (Dubai Municipality, ADAFSA Abu Dhabi, Sharjah Municipality)
mandatory_fields: Name and address of UAE importer/distributor
Date of production and expiry date (Arabic and English)
Halal mark from UAE-recognized certification body (mandatory for meat/poultry; strongly recommended for all food)
Nutrition information (بيانات التغذية) — mandatory per UAE.S 9:2019

nutrition_declaration.format: Per 100g or 100mL. % Daily Value based on UAE NRV (similar to Codex/WHO). Arabic text alongside English.
nutrition_declaration.nrv_reference: UAE/Gulf DRVs aligned with WHO/FAO reference values

allergen_rules.declaration_method: Arabic AND English declaration in ingredient list (bold/contrasting) AND 'Contains' statement
allergen_rules.halal_note: All meat, poultry, and gelatin products must have UAE-recognized Halal certification. Non-Halal products may only be sold in licensed non-Muslim sections of outlets.
allergen_rules.regulatory_basis: UAE.S 9:2019 — General Requirements for Food Labeling

weights_measures.weight_units: SI units (metric) mandatory. Arabic numerals required alongside western numerals.
weights_measures.e_mark: No UAE equivalent to EU e-mark — follow UAE.S metrology requirements
weights_measures.regulatory_basis: UAE Federal Law No. 6 of 2008 on Consumer Protection; UAE.S 9:2019

language_requirements.mandatory_language: Arabic is mandatory for all required label declarations (constitutionally required)
language_requirements.english_required: English highly recommended and practically required for most imported products
language_requirements.minimum_font_size: Minimum 1.5mm for mandatory text; Arabic text must be equal size or larger than other languages

prohibited_claims: Disease claims without MOH approval
False Halal claims — serious criminal offence in UAE
Misleading country of origin claims
Health claims not substantiated by scientific evidence

claim_rules.organic: Emirates organic certification or recognition of equivalent foreign certification
claim_rules.health_claims: Require MOH UAE pre-approval for therapeutic/health benefit claims

special_requirements: Arabic language label is LEGALLY MANDATORY — products without Arabic labeling are refused entry at UAE customs
Halal certification from UAE-accredited body mandatory for meat, poultry, gelatin, and any products claiming to be Halal
Pork and pork-derived ingredients must be clearly labelled (sold only in licensed outlets)
Alcohol-containing products regulated separately — not permitted for general sale
Best before / expiry date: must be at least 30% of shelf life remaining on import
Products from Israel: historically restricted — UAE-Israel normalization (2020 Abraham Accords) has changed this but verify current import status
Each emirate (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah) may have additional requirements — check local municipality
enforcement_notes: UAE customs and municipality authorities actively enforce Arabic label requirements. Products without Arabic labels are 100% refused at port of entry. Dubai Municipality operates one of the region's most sophisticated food safety surveillance systems.

regulatory_basis: SFDA Food Labeling Regulation; GSO 9:2013 (Gulf Technical Regulation for Food Labeling)
mandatory_fields: Importer/local agent name and address in Saudi Arabia
Production and expiry date (Arabic and English)
Halal certificate/mark from recognized body (mandatory for meat/poultry; required for SFDA registration)

mandatory_nutrients: Key vitamins and minerals if claimed
nutrition_declaration.format: Per 100g/100mL mandatory. % DV based on Saudi/Gulf reference values. Arabic language. SFDA Front-of-Pack scheme under development.
nutrition_declaration.nrv_reference: Gulf/Saudi DRVs (Dietary Reference Values) aligned with WHO/FAO

allergen_rules.declaration_method: Arabic AND English in ingredient list (bold) AND separate 'Contains' statement
allergen_rules.halal_note: Non-Halal ingredients (pork, alcohol, non-Halal meat) must be clearly declared. Saudi Arabia: pork and alcohol prohibited — products containing them cannot be imported.

language_requirements.mandatory_language: Arabic mandatory for all required declarations
language_requirements.english_supplement: English may supplement Arabic but Arabic takes precedence

prohibited_claims: Disease claims without SFDA authorisation
False Halal claims — criminal offence in KSA
Misleading nutritional claims
Alcohol content claims
special_requirements: Arabic label MANDATORY — products refused at Saudi customs without Arabic label
Halal certification from SFDA-recognized body mandatory for food products
Pork and all pork derivatives prohibited — cannot be imported into Saudi Arabia
Alcohol — completely prohibited
Minimum remaining shelf life of 50% required at import
Israeli-origin products historically prohibited — verify current status
SFDA notification number required on label for registered products
E-commerce food sales require same labeling compliance
enforcement_notes: SFDA has one of the most active import surveillance programmes in the Middle East. Non-compliant products face destruction. Saudi Arabia enforces halal integrity aggressively — false Halal claims result in criminal prosecution. The SFDA Inspection and Monitoring Authority conducts regular market sweeps.

regulatory_basis: ANVISA RDC 429/2020 (Nutritional Labeling); ANVISA RDC 727/2022 (General Food Labeling); INMETRO regulations
competent_authority: ANVISA (Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária); MAPA for agricultural products
mandatory_fields: Lista de ingredientes (ingredient list — descending order)
Data de fabricação e validade (manufacture and expiry date)
Identificação da origem (manufacturer/importer name and CNPJ)
País de origem (country of origin for imported)
Informações de preparo (preparation instructions if applicable)
Front-of-pack warning labels (selos de advertência) if thresholds exceeded (MANDATORY since October 2022)

nutrition_declaration.format: Per 100g/mL AND per serving. % Daily Value (%VD). Added sugars mandatory (UNIQUE in South America). Energy in both kJ and kcal. Black octagonal front-of-pack warning seals mandatory if nutrients exceed thresholds.
nutrition_declaration.nrv_reference: Brazilian Dietary Reference Values per ANVISA RDC 429/2020 Annex
nutrition_declaration.warning_seals: ALTO EM: AÇÚCARES ADICIONADOS (>15g/100g solid or >7.5g/100mL liquid), GORDURAS SATURADAS (>6g/100g or >3g/100mL), SÓDIO (>600mg/100g or >300mg/100mL)

allergen_rules.declaration_method: Bold in ingredient list AND mandatory statement: 'Alérgenos: CONTÉM [allergen]' after ingredient list
allergen_rules.regulatory_basis: ANVISA RDC 26/2015 — Allergen Information in Packaged Foods
allergen_rules.cross_contact: 'Pode conter' (may contain) statement if cross-contact risk exists

weights_measures.weight_units: Metric SI units mandatory. INMETRO enforces measurement accuracy.
weights_measures.regulatory_basis: INMETRO — Portaria INMETRO No. 157/2002; Consumer Protection Code (CDC)

language_requirements.mandatory_language: Portuguese mandatory for all required declarations
language_requirements.font_minimum: Minimum 1mm font height for mandatory information

prohibited_claims: Disease cure or treatment claims
Misleading comparative claims
Claims that suggest product is beneficial for weight management without substantiation
Claims that minimize health risks of excessive consumption

claim_rules.organic: IBD, Ecocert or other MAPA-accredited organic certification; Selo Brasil Orgânico

special_requirements: Black octagonal warning seals mandatory since October 2022 for excess added sugars, saturated fat, and sodium — highly visible, on front of pack
'NÃO CONTÉM GLÚTEN' or 'CONTÉM GLÚTEN' declaration mandatory for all products
Organic products must display 'ORGÂNICO' and official Brazil organic seal
Transgenic (GMO) products: mandatory triangle symbol with T and 'TRANSGÊNICO'
CNPJ (company tax registration number) of manufacturer/importer mandatory on label
Irradiated foods must be labelled (circular symbol with stylized rays)
ANVISA registration number (if product category requires registration)
enforcement_notes: ANVISA's front-of-pack warning label system (Resolução RDC 429/2020) is now fully in force — this is one of the strictest FOP labeling requirements globally. MAPA enforces labeling for organic, wine, and agricultural products separately. State and municipal health authorities conduct market surveillance.

regulatory_basis: NOM-051-SCFI/SSA1-2010 as amended in 2020 — General Specifications for Labeling of Pre-Packaged Foods
mandatory_fields: Fecha de caducidad o de consumo preferente (expiry or best before date)
Nombre y domicilio del fabricante, importador o distribuidor
Leyendas o sellos de advertencia (warning legends/seals if applicable)
Instrucciones de uso o preparación (if applicable)
Código de barras (barcode — industry standard but practically mandatory for retail)

nutrition_declaration.format: GDA (Guideline Daily Amount) table format per NOM-051. Per serving AND per 100g. Front-of-pack black octagonal warning seals mandatory since October 2020.
nutrition_declaration.nrv_reference: Mexican Dietary Reference Values (Valores de Referencia de Nutrientes — VRN) per NOM-051
nutrition_declaration.warning_seals: EXCESO CALORÍAS: >274 kcal/100g solid / >70 kcal/100mL liquid; EXCESO AZÚCARES: >10g/100g solid / >5g/100mL; EXCESO GRASAS SATURADAS: >4g/100g solid; EXCESO SODIO: >300mg/100g solid / >150mg/100mL; EXCESO GRASAS TRANS: if trans fat present

allergen_rules.declaration_method: Bold in ingredient list AND separate 'Contiene:' statement

weights_measures.net_weight_position: Principal display panel (30% or more of label area)
weights_measures.weight_units: SI metric units mandatory. Consumer Protection Law enforces accuracy.
weights_measures.regulatory_basis: NOM-051; NMX-F standards; Ley Federal sobre Metrología y Normalización

language_requirements.mandatory_language: Spanish mandatory for all required declarations
language_requirements.font_minimum: Minimum 1mm character height for mandatory text

prohibited_claims: Disease treatment or cure claims
Claims that minimize effects of warning seals
Cartoon characters or celebrities targeting children on products with warning seals (effective 2023)
Claims such as 'natural', 'light' without meeting criteria per NOM-051

claim_rules.organic: SAGARPA organic certification; Sello México Orgánico

special_requirements: Black octagonal warning seals MANDATORY since October 2020 — one of the strictest FOP labeling systems globally
Cartoon characters and celebrity endorsements PROHIBITED on products bearing warning seals (targeting children restriction)
Products with warning seals cannot be sold in schools or advertised to children under 14
No free toys/gifts with products bearing warning seals
NOM-051 amendment 2020 is comprehensive — exporters must update all Mexico-market labels
Codex ADI limits referenced but national limits apply via NOM standards
enforcement_notes: COFEPRIS enforces food labeling. The 2020 NOM-051 amendment created one of the world's most aggressive front-of-pack warning label systems. Non-compliant products are not cleared by customs. Advertising restrictions for products with warning seals are heavily enforced by COFEPRIS and the Federal Consumer Attorney (PROFECO).

regulatory_basis: Foodstuffs, Cosmetics and Disinfectants Act (FCD Act) 1972; R. 146 of 2010 (Labeling and Advertising of Foodstuffs); R. 127 of 2014 (Fortification)
competent_authority: Department of Health; DAFF for agricultural products; NRCS for metrology
mandatory_fields: List of ingredients (descending order by mass)
Name and address of manufacturer, packer, or importer
Date marking (best before or use by)

nutrition_declaration.format: Per 100g mandatory. Energy in kJ (kilojoules) not kcal — South Africa uses kJ predominantly. 'Glycaemic carbohydrate' is South Africa-specific terminology. % NRV based on South African Reference Values.
nutrition_declaration.nrv_reference: South African Nutrient Reference Values (NRVs) per Department of Health
nutrition_declaration.note: South Africa uses kJ as primary energy unit and 'glycaemic carbohydrate' — terminology unique to RSA food labeling regulations

allergen_rules.declaration_method: Bold in ingredient list AND 'Contains:' statement. 'May contain:' for cross-contact.

weights_measures.weight_units: Metric SI mandatory. NRCS (National Regulator for Compulsory Specifications) enforces.
weights_measures.regulatory_basis: Trade Metrology Act 77 of 1973; R. 146 of 2010

language_requirements.mandatory_language: English mandatory. Any of South Africa's 11 official languages may be added.
language_requirements.note: South Africa has 11 official languages — English is the default language of commerce and regulation. Afrikaans commonly appears alongside English on major retailer products.

prohibited_claims: Disease cure or treatment claims on food
Misleading nutrient content claims
Claims that vitamins/minerals 'prevent diseases' without substantiation
'No cholesterol' claims on plant foods (misleading as plants inherently have no cholesterol)
special_requirements: Energy declaration in kJ is primary in South Africa — differs from most global markets
'Glycaemic carbohydrate' terminology is uniquely South African
Irradiated foods must display the internationally recognized radura symbol
Kosher and Halal certification commercially important for export and specific market segments
SADC (Southern African Development Community) harmonisation in progress — may affect requirements
Products containing GM ingredients must disclose this on label
Proposed Front-of-Pack Nutritional Labeling (FOP-NL) scheme under development — watch for updates
enforcement_notes: South Africa is modernising its food labeling regulations — R. 146 of 2010 is being replaced by new regulations. The Regulations Relating to the Labeling and Advertising of Foods (R.429 of 2019) are finalised but implementation is ongoing. Exporters should monitor DAFF and DoH for updates.
